title: Decide scope and oracle for password-protected Guitar Pro files
scope: Determine whether protected GP8 files are an actionable parity target when the pinned AlphaTab reader also lacks decryption support.
acceptance: Document actual protected-file container behavior using an authorized test fixture or authoritative format evidence.
Record existing parse-error behavior and whether an independent validation oracle exists.
Keep this outside implementable parity work until the scope and oracle are concrete; file a bounded follow-up only with that evidence.
exclusions: Do not bypass passwords or infer authorization for protected third-party files.

reproduction.instructions: Document actual protected-file container behavior using an authorized test fixture or authoritative format evidence.
